name: W10 Smart Watch 45mm – 10 in 1 Strap Edition | Bluetooth Call | Fitness Tracker | Heart Rate Monitor | Sports Mode | Waterproof | Stylish Design for Men & Women
description:
Highlights:

Stylish & Modern Design – Premium look with high-resolution display

10 Straps Included – Customize your look every day

Multiple Watch Faces – Personalize your smartwatch

Fitness & Health Tracking – Heart rate, steps, sleep monitoring

Bluetooth Call & Notifications – Stay connected on the go

Long Battery Life – Enjoy extended usage

Water-Resistant Build – For everyday use

Product Overview

Introducing the W10 Smart Watch (45mm) – 10 in 1 Strap Edition.
Experience a perfect balance of style and technology with a large 45mm display, multiple sports modes, health monitoring, and Bluetooth connectivity.

This special edition comes with 10 interchangeable straps, allowing you to match your watch with any outfit or occasion. Whether at the gym, office, or social events – you’ll always have the right look.

Key Features

Large 45mm Display with high-quality visuals

Heart Rate & Blood Pressure Monitoring

Step Counter & Calorie Tracker

Bluetooth Calling & Smart Notifications

Multiple Watch Faces & Customization Options

Long-Lasting Battery Life

10 Stylish Straps Included

Perfect for both men and women, the W10 is designed to be your ultimate daily companion.

What's in the Box?

1x W10 Smart Watch (45mm)

10x Interchangeable Straps

1x Magnetic Charging Cable

1x User Manual
